Ring A1/A2 moves y+-6 with the beam, carrying on-beam blocks; pushed chains must stay inside the colour-4 field or the whole move cancels.
Beam A4/A3 changes w by 6. Any block on the beam rows at x == tip-4 is hooked (no tag check), and every block fully on the beam follows the tip.
An unhooked extend pushes blocks in the swept strip. A blocked group (leaves the field or hits the ring) lets the beam move alone.
Tags: a hooked next block becomes collected when the other on-beam blocks are collected; a collected block off the beam reverts to next. Legend centre 0 = collected.
